ideas.pitch: An advanced line-following robot utilizing an array of QTR-8RC reflectance sensors and a finely-tuned PID control algorithm running on an ESP32 microcontroller to maximize cornering speeds without losing track contact.
ideas.title: PID-Optimized High-Speed Line Follower
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core judging criteria of track completion time and path-following accuracy by replacing crude threshold logic with real-time mathematical error correction.

ideas.pitch: A robust autonomous rover that combines an optical line sensor array with an MPU6050 IMU to detect sharp turns and dead ends preemptively, applying inertial corrections before visual drift causes boundary violations.
ideas.title: Dual-Sensor Fusion Adaptive Line Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes checkpoint penalties and boundary violations by anticipating complex track geometries rather than reacting solely to momentary sensor loss.

ideas.pitch: A custom 25x25cm laser-cut and 3D-printed chassis engineered for maximum aerodynamic stability, featuring adjustable wheel baselines and an easily accessible modular electronics deck to prevent size limit disqualifications.
ideas.title: Modular 3D-Printed Low-Center-of-Gravity Chassis
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures absolute compliance with the strict physical dimension limits while providing superior weight distribution to shave crucial seconds off final lap times.

ideas.pitch: A line-following robot equipped with an onboard OLED status display and tactile override buttons that log exact error states, lap times, and checkpoint re-entry counts for rapid manual debugging during penalty phases.
ideas.title: Smart Checkpoint Recovery & Telemetry Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides transparent diagnostic feedback that helps teams optimize their path parameters between the qualification round and the more complex final round.

ideas.pitch: A specialized firmware module for autonomous line followers that detects perpendicular junction markers and cross-intersections, executing pre-programmed navigational logic to navigate complex multi-path tracks accurately.
ideas.title: Optical Mark Recognition & Intersection Switcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives an edge in the final round where tracks feature complex layouts and multi-branch pathways requiring precise decision-making beyond simple line tracking.
